name: mala3by-email-worker
description: Cloudflare Worker -- polls Supabase notification_queue (channel='email') on a Cron Trigger and sends transactional email via Resend. Same architectural shape as ../whatsapp-worker's connector (poll -> render -> send -> update status), but stateless -- no Durable Object, no long-lived session, since a REST API call per message needs none. See EMAIL_NOTIFICATION_AUDIT_2026-08-23.md for the audited recommendation this scaffold implements.
